theorems.name: Submission.rsd_cmr_support_eq_inter
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (T₀ : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (c : ℝ), IsOpen V → c ≠ 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, T (testFormOnInclusion hVU n ω) = c * T₀ ω) → T₀.support = T.support ∩ V
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
